verdict.rationale: Apify ships a CLI, SDKs and a hosted platform, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any way to opt out of them. The CLI, MCP and API documentation covers other capabilities and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
